critical_findings.description: 30 messages across 4 channels (dg-practices-to-sorters, dg-algo-to-sorters, dg-docs-1-to-prog, dg-docs-1-to-sorters) are missing required Proto A fields (id, channel, team, agent_id, body, ts). These were written by agents NOT using the BusWriter class, bypassing schema validation.
critical_findings.impact: BusReader.poll() will skip these messages (they fail Message.from_json_line deserialization), so the data is effectively lost to Proto A consumers.
critical_findings.remediation: All agents must use BusWriter.publish() or ensure messages include all required fields: id, type, channel, team, agent_id, ts, body.

critical_findings.description: 58 messages use message types not in VALID_MSG_TYPES. Invalid types found: finding, findings, findings-summary, tool_delivery, tool-request, tool-requests, status, batch_complete.
critical_findings.impact: BusWriter.publish() would reject these (raises ValueError), confirming these were written by non-Proto-A writers. Proto A readers using type-based filtering will miss these messages.
critical_findings.remediation: Either (a) extend VALID_MSG_TYPES in bus.py to include the new types, or (b) have agents map their custom types to the existing valid types (e.g., 'finding' -> 'info').

critical_findings.description: 53 expired messages (past their TTL) remain in bus JSONL files. No active EpochRotator or cleanup process is running.
critical_findings.impact: Bus files will grow unboundedly (RE-1 concern). BusReader.poll() filters expired messages at read time, so correctness is maintained, but disk usage and read performance degrade over time.
critical_findings.remediation: Start a Coordinator instance or run EpochRotator.cleanup_old_epochs() periodically.

critical_findings.description: No SQLite database files found in /root/.claude-agent-comm/db/. SharedState (agent registry, rate limits, phase signals) is not initialized.
critical_findings.impact: Agent heartbeats, coordinator watchdog, rate limiting, and phase signals are non-functional. The multi-agent system is running in a degraded mode relying solely on JSONL bus communication.
critical_findings.remediation: Initialize SharedState by starting a Coordinator instance or calling SharedState(db_path) directly.

source_code_bugs.description: TOCTOU window: after renaming the original file, if the read of the renamed file fails (OSError), it attempts to rename it back. But a writer may have already created a new file at the original path. The os.rename(tmp_read, filepath) would then overwrite the new file, losing messages written during the repair window.
Channel name sanitization only handles '/' and '..' but allows spaces, unicode, null bytes, and other special characters that could cause filesystem issues or security problems.
Uses file mtime for age determination instead of parsing the epoch tag from the filename. A file that is touched (e.g., by backup software) would have its mtime reset, preventing cleanup.
No maximum length validation on channel names. Extremely long channel names could exceed filesystem path limits (typically 255 chars for filename, 4096 for full path).

Default coordinator death handler only logs and sets stop_event. No actual work-saving logic is implemented. Comment says 'In production this would save in-progress work before exiting' but no mechanism exists.
